headline: Apple to shut down its 28-year-old Support Community forum Nov 20
summary: Apple is shutting down its online Support Community discussion forum on November 20, having already placed it into read-only mode. The 28-year-old forum let users exchange advice and troubleshoot Apple products, and the fate of its archive after closure is unclear.
